litematica_schematic_sync.name: Litematica Schematic Sync
litematica_schematic_sync.description: Cloud, LAN, and GitHub Gist schematic synchronization companion mod for Litematica on Fabric.
litematica_schematic_sync.config.comment: Automatically broadcast and listen for schematic peers on the local subnet via UDP multicast / mDNS.
UDP port used for broadcasting discovery heartbeats (default 25575).
TCP port used for direct peer-to-peer schematic streaming (default 25576).
Fine-grained or classic token with 'gist' scope to enable automated cloud upload/download.
When true, newly uploaded schematic gists are publicly viewable. False creates secret unlisted gists.
Create a timestamped backup in schematics/.backup before replacing an existing schematic file.
Display in-game toast popups when schematics are sent, received, or discovered.
litematica_schematic_sync.hotkey.quick_s: Quick Share Active Schematic via LAN
litematica_schematic_sync.hotkey.quick_u: Quick Upload Active Schematic to Gist
